title: Motion for an extension of time to file respondent's brief on the merits

P.O. Box 3610               Telephone: (303) 948-1489

January 9, 2026

Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
Washington, D.C. 20543

RE: United States of America v. Ali Danial Hemani
  S.Ct. No. 24-1234

Dear Mr. Harris:

The petition for writ of certiorari in the above-captioned case was granted on
October 20, 2025, and the petitioner’s opening brief was filed on December 12, 2025.
Mr. Hemani’s brief in response is currently due on January 20, 2026. Argument is set
for March 2, 2026.

Pursuant to Rule 30.4, Mr. Hemani respectfully requests a three-day extension of
time to and including January 23, 2026, within which to file his brief in opposition.
The extension is requested due to recent changes in Mr. Hemani’s representation.
The Solicitor General, counsel for the United States, is unopposed to this request.

Sincerely,


/s/ Zachary L. Newland
Zachary L. Newland
